adds.title: Cabinet of Bangladesh decision, 11 November 2013, chaired by PM Sheikh Hasina
adds.summary: On 11 November 2013 the Bangladesh cabinet chaired by Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina recognized Hijras as a separate gender alongside male and female, to be referred to as Hijra in both English and Bangla, with priority for education and other rights, noting approximately 10,000 Hijras identified in a Ministry of Social Welfare survey who were already enlisted as voters.

adds.title: U.S. human rights report 2022 and Bangladesh government response
adds.summary: Released April 13, 2022, the U.S. Bangladesh 2021 Human Rights Report covers LGBT rights, and in response on April 17, 2022 Bangladesh's Ministry of Foreign Affairs declared that treating LGBT rights and same-sex marriage as human rights is a regrettable and uncalled-for imposition of values from a select few countries.
